summary: PRD v0.6 and revision 22 preserve the approved Electron macOS/Windows bootstrap, app-owned OpenCode v2 sidecar, and full F-01–18 product goal. The exact nine-document approval remains valid. No material product scope or acceptance contradiction was found. This passes the product-document gate only; bootstrap completion and full-product readiness remain unproven.

artifacts.review_scope: Full product semantics and bootstrap compatibility
Decisions, acceptance, checks and approval registrations
Cited product capability evidence and limitations
Relevant full-product scope, sequencing and acceptance

observations: All nine current file digests and registered versions match the approved packet and contract. Packet and receipt hashes also match their registrations.

The PRD states a single-user development and learning problem, explicitly disclaims measured demand and time-saving evidence, and provides observable acceptance scenarios, a CLI-independent usage outcome and a measurable learning threshold.

Revision 22 limits bootstrap recovery to visible disconnection followed by a clean app restart. It does not retire the full product's reconnection, event-gap reconciliation or duplicate-effect requirements.
Preview absence is a bounded bootstrap state. F-10 preview functionality and its separate isolation gate remain required before that capability is exposed.

Approval remains limited to disposable synthetic workspace/configuration and the planned bootstrap. Persistence decisions remain held; personal projects, global credentials/configuration, ambient services, telemetry and public release are excluded.
Windows runtime evidence and macOS GUI evidence remain absent. Static checks and macOS package output cannot satisfy these completion requirements.
method: Read-only independent semantic review under solo-product-review; inspected the registered active plan/contract, full PRD, approval packet/receipt, cited local research and relevant parent/design requirements. Verified exact document digests and current product review-input binding.
limits: No files, app, tests, installation, runtime probe or external call modified or executed.
Approved documents received integrity and targeted contradiction checks; they were not all re-reviewed as design specifications.
No implemented-UI, platform-runtime, security-enforcement, user-demand or full-product acceptance attestation.

provenance.routing_basis: Coordinator-reported explicit routing in registered dispatch; not independently observed runtime identity
